label: defect

source.note: Operator, 2026-10-31: a grave failure of reasoning, not of code. satelle substrate review (0.0.815, sty_08f747ad) was designed to put every substrate item's text and its whole rejection history into one reviewer prompt — 1.8 MB on id4me — although the reviewer seat has a read grant, the satelle CLI, and every item on disk; only the instruction and a manifest were needed. The planner designed it, the plan, architecture, code-ac and integration reviews accepted it, and the driving session shipped it and then proposed size-bounded batches — the same mistake again.

summary: Dispatch-pointers rule (satelle-dispatch-pointers), reject side, at the code gate. change.diff is a labelled reconstruction of the sty_08f747ad judge-payload builder the code-ac review accepted: it reads every substrate item's body from disk and every rejection note from the ledger and copies them into the reviewer's stdin payload, although that seat can read the same files and run the same CLI. The captured operator note (sty_73a2dc68's card) names the defect, including that code-ac review accepted it. Pair: implementation-dispatch-manifest-valid.
